faqLeft.q: What engine does the Sprinter 415–519 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the model year and output. The NCV3 generation (2006–2018) used two engines: the OM651 2.1-litre four-cylinder diesel and the OM642 3.0-litre V6 diesel. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Sprinter 415–519 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200 for the OM651 (4-cyl) and £2,800 for the OM642 (V6). Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Sprinter 415–519 CDI?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM651 or the OM642 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM651 Sprinter 415–519 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn injector seals and timing chain components as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 Sprinter 415–519 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, injector seals and swirl flaps as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Sprinter 415–519 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Sprinter if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Sprinter 415–519 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Sprinter 415–519 CDI owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
